@@U02371@@
—It whizzed past my hair!
—I felt it on my feet!
—None of us are hurt.
—But we've all had a fright.
—The fun’s over.
—lIt’s what they wanted, the beasts!

@@U02373@@
Long the herald of your masquerades,
I’ve stood at the gate and never failed
to keep from the hall any evil
to disturb your revels.
But now, I fear, airborne spirits
are surging through every window,
and I know nothing to save you from ghosts or sorcery.
The dwarf was suspicious enough,
but now at the back there’s a mighty onrush of figures
whose meaning I'd like to expound,
except I know nothing about them,
and I ask your help.
There! Look!
Swerving through the crowd
a glorious four-spanned coach,
though it clears no path,
no one makes way,
no one pushes or shoves to get back.
And there, far off,
stars, glittering, rising, many-colored,
shining, shifting,
like a magic-lantern aglow,
and on it comes snorting like a mighty storm.
Make way!
I shudder to see it!

@@U02375@@
Halt, my coursers!
Slow, there, slow down!

@@U02373@@
长久以来，你的化装舞会的先驱，
I’ve stood at the gate and never failed
to keep from the hall any evil
打扰你的狂欢。
但现在，我担心，空气中的灵魂
涌入每一扇窗户，
我不知道什么可以把你从鬼魂或巫术中拯救出来。
The dwarf was suspicious enough,
但现在后面有一大群人涌来
whose meaning I'd like to expound,
除了我对他们一无所知
我请求你的帮助。
那里！看！
Swerving through the crowd
a glorious four-spanned coach,
though it clears no path,
没有人让路，
no one pushes or shoves to get back.
而在那遥远的地方，
stars, glittering, rising, many-colored,
闪耀、变幻、
like a magic-lantern aglow,
and on it comes snorting like a mighty storm.
让路！
看到它我不寒而栗！

@@U02375@@
停下来，我的赛马们！
慢点，那里，慢点！
